parts.text: Move the burlap pig mask onto his face: he is wearing it, the stitched burlap pig mask with its snout and teeth fully covering his face from brow to chin, strapped on, nothing floating beside his head. His bald head top and grey side tufts show above and behind the mask. Make all visible skin and the hands clearly 3D claymation: smooth matte plasticine, simplified sculpted forms, no realistic skin wrinkles. Keep everything else identical: two-handed chainsaw, denim jacket, tool belt, medical backpack, lakeside cabin backdrop, pose, head turned about 45 degrees right. No text.
